item.title: Kosodate o Oeta Tsuma ga Daigaku ni Kayoi Hajimete kara...... ~Musuko no Yuujin to no Saikai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Heiantei
  • 発売日: 2023-09-08
  • スコア: 6.88/10 (87 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 子育てを終えた妻が大学に通い始めてから……～息子の友人との再会～
  • 英語名: Kosodate o Oeta Tsuma ga Daigaku ni Kayoi Hajimete kara…… Musuko no Yuujin to no Saikai

あらすじ

“Phew…” Chihiro sighs as she vacuums her daughter’s room.

In the past, she used to vacuum the room she was in every day. Now that her daughter went to college and started living alone, it was enough for her to clean once a week. The same goes for the room of her eldest son, who left home two years ago. Chihiro leaves her daughter’s room, feeling a sense of hopelessness.

item.title: Moto Yan Oku-san to Gyaru Musume-chan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Heiantei
  • 発売日: 2018-09-02
  • スコア: 7.33/10 (186 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 元ヤン奥さんとギャル娘ちゃん
  • 英語名: Moto Yan Oku-san to Gyaru Musume-chan

别名

  • 元ヤン奥さんとギャル娘ちゃん ～召しませ母娘丼～ パッケージ版

あらすじ

The first love of our protagonist, Shouta, is his neighbor Yoshihata Nao, a married woman who was a delinquent back in high school. She’s known Shouta since he was a baby and treats him like a little brother.

Having a lazy husband with debts, Nao has to work especially hard to support her family. But lately, she is more worried about her daughter, Yoshihata Natsuhi, who has become a gal and doesn’t seem to care about her future. Because of this, Nao asks Shouta to be her daughter’s tutor and help Natsuhi with her studies.

あらすじ

Erina, an arrogant and prideful countess.

Despite her skills, which once earned her the title of knight commander—

Now a slave, Erina clings to the pride of her noble upbringing.
